items.title: Bill Goodwin interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 28, 2025
items.q: I was actually that year that Gary called me to play... when I wasn’t on the road with Gary.

ctx.x: What was your reason for coming east?
And how does that work? You get a recommendation? Somebody recommends you, you happen to cross paths on Fifth Avenue or how does that thing occur?
